steps.title: Transfer beads and remove supernatant
steps.instruction: Move bead slurry from the reagent plate (slot 4) to the working plate (slot 1) with the 8‑channel pipette, then engage the magnetic module and discard the supernatant.

substeps.instruction: Transfer bead slurry from reagent plate (slot 4) to working plate (slot 1) using the 8‑channel pipette.
Activate magnetic module and remove supernatant.

steps.title: Transfer antibody solution
steps.instruction: Aspirate the antibody solution from the reagent plate (slot 4) and dispense it into the working plate (slot 1) using the 8‑channel pipette.

steps.title: Transfer and mix samples
steps.instruction: Transfer each sample from the 96‑deepwell plate (slot 5) to the working plate (slot 1) with the 8‑channel pipette, then mix by pipetting up and down ten times per well.

substeps.instruction: Transfer samples from 96‑deepwell plate (slot 5) to working plate (slot 1) using the 8‑channel pipette.
Mix each well by pipetting up and down 10 times.

steps.title: Seal plate and place on shaker
steps.instruction: Seal the working plate securely and relocate it to a shaker for incubation.

substeps.instruction: Move the sealed plate to a shaker.
